mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product) product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku) sku_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 'ON_SALE') on_sale_product_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(available_stock) FROM inventory), 0) available_stock_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE available_stock < #{lowStockThreshold}) low_stock_sku_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'CREATED') created_order_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'CREATED'), 0) created_order_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_trace) ai_interaction_count

SELECT o.order_no, o.status, o.total_amount, o.currency, COUNT(oi.id) item_count, o.created_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'CREATED' GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.total_amount, o.currency, o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(provider_name), 'NONE') provider, COALESCE(MAX(provider_mode), 'NONE') provider_mode, COUNT(*) interaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN answer_status = 'ANSWERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) answered_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN answer_status IN ('UNSUPPORTED_QUESTION', 'INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) unsupported_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fallback_used = TRUE OR answer_status = 'FALLBACK_ANSWER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) fallback_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN answer_status = 'PROVIDER_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) provider_error_count, MAX(created_at) latest_interaction_at FROM ai_trace
